title: Aftercode Portfolio Intelligence CMS
shortDescription: Autonomous multi-repo AST analyzer, Remotion video reel engine, and developer portfolio CMS with zero-cost media generation.
description: Aftercode Portfolio CMS automates codebase analysis across local and remote GitHub repositories. It parses AST import graphs, extracts REST API endpoints, determines technology stack tokens, generates 4K OpenGraph thumbnails with Playwright, and renders programmatic MP4 video reels with Remotion.
targetAudience: Software Engineers, Tech Leads, Recruiter hiring teams
myContributions: Designed zero-hallucination AST heuristic extraction pipeline matching package manifests.
Built Playwright screenshot capture and Remotion video composition engine for $0 API video generation.
Implemented minimalist fruity light theme UI design system with responsive card layouts.
Engineered local sandboxed repository clone and cleanup system.
architectureDiagram:
graph TD
    CLI["CLI Tool (Node.js/Commander)"] -->|"Clones repo to sandbox"| Sandbox["Workspace Sandbox"]
    Sandbox -->|"Reads package.json & AST"| AST["AST & Metadata Parser"]
    AST -->|"Validates tech stack"| Verification["Evidence Verifier"]
    Verification -->|"Saves JSON output"| JSONStore["output/metadata/*.json"]
    JSONStore -->|"Syncs data"| ReactUI["React + Vite Portfolio CMS UI"]
    ReactUI -->|"Renders visual reels"| Remotion["Remotion MP4 Engine"]
    ReactUI -->|"Renders cover cards"| Playwright["Playwright Thumbnail Generator"]
features: Minimalist Fruity Design System & Responsive Layouts
